senses.sense_definition: To a small or moderate extent or degree; a little bit.

examples.text: The instructions for the new software were <w>somewhat</w> confusing at first.

examples.text: The final results were <w>somewhat</w> different from what we had anticipated.

target_lang_translations.pl: Wyniki końcowe były <w>nieco</w> inne, niż przewidywaliśmy.

senses.sense_definition: Something; an unspecified thing or amount.

target_lang_translations.de: Es liegt <w>etwas</w> in seinem Verhalten, das darauf hindeutet, dass er die Wahrheit verbirgt.
